Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specification DIESEL GENERATOR SET-125 KVA 1. ENGINE i. Diesel Engine, which is a 6 Cylinder, 4 stroke in-line water cooled engine with max power output of 155.55 BHP (116KW), with Electronic controlled Sedmac governor, electric start and designed to ru n at 1500 rpm continuous on 100% load & also capable to take 10% overload for 1 hours out of 12 hours of operation. Complies with current CPCB emission norms (as per GSR.448 (E) - MoEF, Govt. of India) 2. Engine and Block i. Optimized cast iron cylinder block with optimum distribution of forces ii. Drop forged steel connecting rods

iii. Crankshaft hardened bearing surfaces and fillets for moderate load on main iv. and big-end bearings v. Keystone Top compression rings for long service life. Replaceable valve vi. guide and valve seats. vii. Lift eyelets viii. SAE 3 Flywheel Housing and SAE 10 Flywheel. ix. Fixed integrated radiator. x. Fully electronic control Isochronous governing. a. Lubrication System i. Full flow disposable spin-on oil filter for extra high filtration. ii. Rotary displacement oil pump driven by the crankshaft. iii. Deep front oil sump. iv. Short oil dip stick at front. v. Integrated full flow oil cooler, side mounted. vi. Oil Change Period 600hrs or 12 months whichever is earlier. b. Fuel system i. SAPL rotary FIP. ii. Plunger type fuel feed pump. iii. Five hole fuel injection nozzles. iv. Electronic Governor – A0 ClassSpin on type fuel filter for longer duration. c. Intake and exhaust system i. Connection flange for exhaust line. a. Cooling system i. Poly V belt driven, maintenance-free coolant pump with high degree of efficiency ii. Efficient cooling with accurate cooling control through a water distribution ducting iii. the Cylinder block. iv. Reliable thermostat with minimum pressure drop. v. Aluminum Radiator with Pusher fan. b. Electrical System i. 12 VDC electrical system with digital control panel ii. Engine maintenance system 2 (EMS2), an electronically controlled iii. processing system which optimizes engine performance. iv. It also includes advanced facilities for diagnostics and fault tracing. v. Sensors for oil pressure, water temperature. vi. Connected with Sedmac governor. vii. 3. ALTERNATOR i. 125 KVA single bearing alternator suitable for operation at 1500 rpm, 0.8 pf (lag) suitable for 50 Hz, 3 phase, 4 wire system, conforming to BS 5000 / IS 4722. The Alternators are brushle ss type, screen protected drip proof, revolving field, self- excited, self-regulated through an AVR. ii. 4. ACCOUSTIC ENCLOSURE i. The acoustic enclosure is made of 1.6 mm thick CRCA steel sheets and structural/ sheet meta l base frame painted in White & Blue shade. The walls of the enclosure are insulated wit h fire retardant foam so as to comply with the 75 dBA at 1mtr sound levels specified by CPCB . The Key Features of the Enclosure are: ii. Specially designed to meet CPCBII norms of 75 dBA @ 1mtr at 75% load iii. Four point lifting for easy handling Made on special purpose CNC machines for consistent qua lity & workmanship CRCA used is Powder coated and pre-treated in 7 Stage pre-treatme nt plants for long lasting service life and superior finish With UV resistant powder coating. iv. Insulation material meets exacting IS 8183 specifications for better sound attenuation v. Flush styling - no projections. vi. Fluid drains for lube oil and fuel filling point.

5. BASE FRAME i. Suitable to couple the above mentioned Engine and Alternator, with a C type construction, m ade of 3 mm CRCA Steel. 6. FUEL TANK i. The Gen.set constitutes a 180 Liters Diesel Tank , with Inlet & outlet arrangement with DrainPlug and Air vents 7. BATTERY i. 90 AH Exide make of 12V Battery. 8. OTHER FEATURES i. Robust, Compact, Fuel efficient Diesel Generator sets designed to operate under arduous sit e conditions. ii. Latest Technology & Highly Reliable. iii. Highly Engineered for Optimized Power SOLUTIONS. iv. Can be connected to laptop / computer using RS232 port and monitor all the engine perform ance related data. v. Troubleshooting and fine tuning of engine can be done byusing Electronic Tool. vi. Designed to operate continually 24 x 7 @ 100% load. vii. Better Fuel Consumption. viii. Low Running cost. ix. Compact Foot Print. x. Easy access for maintenance. 9. GENSET CONTROL UNIT i. Genset Control Unit with Integrated E-Governor helps in reading all genset inputs and controls the genset. GCU help in monitoring following parameters: ii. Controls the engine speed (Speed governing). iii. Supports Auto-Mains-Failure (AMF) functionsfor 1-Ph and 3-Ph gen.set. iv. Low Fuel Level. v. Supports Manual-control-Panel (MCP) functions for 1-Ph and 3-Ph gen.set. vi. Measures gen.set voltages & currents. vii. Measures mains supply voltages & amp;currents. viii. Measures mains supply voltages & currents. ix. Measures electrical parameters like Frequency, Power factor, Gen.set Power. x. Monitors critical engine safety parameters. xi. Starts and Stops the gen.set. xii. Have counters for gen.set starts and stops, run hours, kWh, power factor. 10. Contractor has to arrange load test at site or at factory without any additional cost or cl aim. Including First fill of lube oil and Engine safeties – LLOP, HWT, Initial filling of dies el for standard testing procedure up to 6 hours minimum and 12 hours maximum. 11. Necessary concrete platform, roofing, cabling works, electrification works shall be in th e scope of supplier. 12. Bidder should be supply suitable capacity change over switch with enclosure. It is the responsibility of the supplier for loading, unloading, supply, installation, testing & commissioning of the DG set at site. Conditional offer for the above works/specification will leads to disqualification . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
